boundary.description: From the junction of Bentley Hall Road and High Street, N along High Street, then W along Walshaw Road, then S along Crostons Road and W along Bolton Road to its crossing with River Irwell S along the river to the point where Manchester Bury and Bolton Canal starts. Then by a bee line W Hinds Lane and SW through the middle of Elton Reservoir and by a bee line NW to junction of Bolton Road and Watling Street, including Spen Fold, but excluding Higher Spenmoor Farm. West along Bury and Bolton Road (A58) to Bolton-Bury District boundary and along that boundary to its crossing with up to the Old Holts Farm, then by a beeline to and E along Bentley Hall Road to its crossing with High Street.
